This head unit disables WindTone\'s accessibility service after a restart. Tap here to open the accessibility page and turn it back on. If this device has no such page, use usage access instead (About & diagnostics → Foreground app history).

This head unit has no battery optimisation page (common on BYD DiLink). Try any of these paths://n//n1) Settings → Apps → WindTone → Power management → Allow background activity
2) Settings → Battery → App power management → WindTone → Unrestricted
3) Settings → Apps → WindTone → Battery → Not optimised / Allow background

If none exists it still works: as long as the accessibility service stays on, app switches are reported instantly. The allow-list only protects against being frozen after a long standby.

This head unit may not have a standalone Accessibility page (common on BYD DiLink). Try any of these paths://n//n1) Settings → System → Accessibility → Downloaded services → WindTone
2) Settings → Apps → Special app access → Accessibility
3) Settings → Accessibility (some models put it at the very bottom of the list, scroll down)
4) BYD DiLink: Vehicle settings → System settings → Accessibility (the app tries this entry first)

If none of them exists, use Usage access instead: it recognises the foreground app with about a 1.5 s delay, which is enough for the per-app hiding list.

Always on via Media3 single-player continuous queue; tracks with encoder delay/padding play without gaps

WindTone uses one ExoPlayer (Media3) with a continuous MediaItem queue. Media3 reads per-track encoder delay/padding and joins album splits without an audible gap when metadata is present.

There is no Media3 API to turn this off. Forcing gaps would mean inserting silence between tracks, which we deliberately do not do.

How lyrics are found:
1. Sidecar in the same Aliyun Drive folder (.lrc / .krc / .yrc / .txt)
2. Same-named lyric file next to the audio
3. Embedded lyrics (MP3 USLT/SYLT, FLAC/Ogg LYRICS, M4A ©lyr)
4. Lyrics from a same-named track in the local library (local only; no online search)

If a cloud track has none of the above, this hint is shown as-is. Put a same-named lyric file in the cloud folder, or add the song to the local library.
